method: Uninstrumented end-to-end wall timing, no per-stage wrappers. Each version uses a fresh headless process, one discarded warmup and seven measured samples, repeated in reverse version order. All benchmarks are serial. Diagnostic substitutions are temporary-process controls only, not shipped changes.
findings: Before the fix, every job eagerly allocated editable input state, attached an on_lines listener, changed undolevels, and registered input-mode autocmds even if no input was ever used.
Every output batch consequently entered input bookkeeping: building an empty shifted record table, visiting marker maintenance, and using vim.bo proxy accesses on the write path.
Replacing the parser or ANSI writer alone did not consistently explain the slowdown; the initial parser hypothesis was not confirmed by reverse-order trials.

The fix separates the lightweight send session from editable state. on_lines and undo setup now start only on first Insert or :w. In untouched output-only jobs the editable-state lookup is nil, avoiding the input bookkeeping path. Hot option writes use nvim_set_option_value directly.
Two reversed-order final trials reduced 100k ANSI medians in both rounds. Residual overhead and process-to-process variation remain; this is not a claim of zero-cost input support.
limitations: Headless local macOS measurement, not GUI latency.
Host CPU scheduling and LuaJIT behavior are not held constant; intermediate substitution trials showed significant variation.
These experiments identify the combined eager-initialization/output-bookkeeping path; they do not assign a precise share of elapsed time to each individual option or callback.

-- A protected transcript followed by an editable, independently undoable draft.
local M = {}
local states = {}
local ns = vim.api.nvim_create_namespace("compile-mode.input")
local group = vim.api.nvim_create_augroup("compile-mode.input", { clear = false })

local function mark(buf, s)
	vim.api.nvim_buf_clear_namespace(buf, ns, 0, -1)
	if s.start then
		vim.api.nvim_buf_set_extmark(buf, ns, s.start, 0, {
			right_gravity = true,
			virt_text = { { s.active and "  [stdin · :w sends]" or "  [unsent input · process ended]", "Comment" } },
			virt_text_pos = "eol",
		})
	end
end

function M.has_draft(buf)
	local s = states[buf]
	return s and s.start ~= nil and table.concat(s.draft, "\n") ~= "" or false
end

function M.count(buf)
	local s = states[buf]
	return s and s.start or vim.api.nvim_buf_line_count(buf)
end

function M.is_record(buf, row)
	local s = states[buf]
	return s and s.records[row] or false
end

function M.output_count(buf)
	local s = states[buf]
	return M.count(buf) - (s and vim.tbl_count(s.records) or 0)
end

function M.in_draft(buf, win)
	local s = states[buf]
	return s and s.start and vim.api.nvim_win_get_cursor(win or 0)[1] > s.start or false
end

function M.lock(buf)
	if not vim.api.nvim_buf_is_valid(buf) then
		return
	end
	local s = states[buf]
	vim.bo[buf].modifiable = s ~= nil and s.start ~= nil and not s.pending
	vim.bo[buf].modified = M.has_draft(buf)
end

local function settle(buf, s)
	if not s.pending then
		return
	end
	local p = s.pending
	s.pending = nil
	s.editing = true
	vim.bo[buf].modifiable = true
	vim.api.nvim_buf_set_lines(buf, p.first, p.last, false, p.lines)
	s.editing = false
	mark(buf, s)
	M.lock(buf)
end

-- Output writers bracket synchronous text changes. Async highlight work must
-- never toggle modifiable independently of the input owner.
function M.begin_output(buf)
	local s = states[buf]
	if s then
		settle(buf, s)
		s.writing = true
	end
	vim.bo[buf].modifiable = true
end

function M.end_output(buf)
	local s = states[buf]
	if s then
		s.writing = false
		mark(buf, s)
	end
	M.lock(buf)
end

function M.attach(buf, send)
	M.detach(buf)
	local s = { active = true, send = send, draft = { "" }, undo = { { "" } }, index = 1, records = {} }
	states[buf] = s
	vim.bo[buf].buftype = "acwrite"
	vim.bo[buf].bufhidden = "hide"
	s.old_undolevels = vim.bo[buf].undolevels
	-- Native undo includes process output. Keep a separate draft-only journal.
	vim.bo[buf].undolevels = -1
	vim.api.nvim_create_autocmd({ "InsertEnter", "InsertLeave" }, {
		group = group,
		buffer = buf,
		callback = function()
			s.insert_group = false
		end,
	})
	vim.api.nvim_buf_attach(buf, false, {
		on_lines = function(_, b, _, first, last, new_last)
			if states[b] ~= s then
				return true
			end
			if s.editing then
				return
			end
			if s.writing then
				local shifted = {}
				for row in pairs(s.records) do
					if row < first then
						shifted[row] = true
					elseif row >= last then
						shifted[row + new_last - last] = true
					end
				end
				s.records = shifted
				if not s.start then
					return
				end
				local values = vim.api.nvim_buf_get_lines(b, first, new_last, false)
				for _ = first + 1, last do
					table.remove(s.history, first + 1)
				end
				for i = #values, 1, -1 do
					table.insert(s.history, first + 1, values[i])
				end
				s.start = s.start + new_last - last
			elseif not s.start then
				return
			elseif first < s.start then
				local original = {}
				for row = first, last - 1 do
					original[#original + 1] = row < s.start and s.history[row + 1] or s.draft[row - s.start + 1]
				end
				s.pending = { first = first, last = new_last, lines = original }
				vim.bo[b].modifiable = false
				vim.schedule(function()
					if states[b] == s and vim.api.nvim_buf_is_valid(b) then
						settle(b, s)
						vim.notify("Compilation history is read-only", vim.log.levels.WARN)
					end
				end)
			else
				s.draft = vim.api.nvim_buf_get_lines(b, s.start, -1, false)
				if #s.draft == 0 then
					s.draft = { "" }
					s.pending = { first = s.start, last = s.start, lines = { "" } }
					vim.bo[b].modifiable = false
					vim.schedule(function()
						if states[b] == s and vim.api.nvim_buf_is_valid(b) then
							settle(b, s)
						end
					end)
				end
				while #s.undo > s.index do
					table.remove(s.undo)
				end
				local inserting = vim.api.nvim_get_mode().mode:sub(1, 1) == "i"
				if inserting and s.insert_group then
					s.undo[s.index] = vim.deepcopy(s.draft)
				else
					s.undo[#s.undo + 1] = vim.deepcopy(s.draft)
					local limit = math.max(2, vim.go.undolevels + 1)
					if #s.undo > limit then
						table.remove(s.undo, 1)
					end
					s.index = #s.undo
				end
				s.insert_group = inserting
			end
		end,
		on_detach = function()
			if states[buf] == s then
				states[buf] = nil
			end
		end,
	})
end

function M.detach(buf)
	vim.api.nvim_clear_autocmds({ group = group, buffer = buf })
	local s = states[buf]
	if s and vim.api.nvim_buf_is_valid(buf) then
		settle(buf, s)
		vim.bo[buf].undolevels = s.old_undolevels
		vim.api.nvim_buf_clear_namespace(buf, ns, 0, -1)
	end
	states[buf] = nil
end

function M.enter(buf, key)
	local s = states[buf]
	if not s or (not s.active and not s.start) then
		vim.notify("No running compilation", vim.log.levels.WARN)
		return
	end
	settle(buf, s)
	local in_draft = M.in_draft(buf)
	if not s.start then
		s.history = vim.api.nvim_buf_get_lines(buf, 0, -1, false)
		s.start = #s.history
		s.editing = true
		vim.bo[buf].modifiable = true
		vim.api.nvim_buf_set_lines(buf, -1, -1, false, { "" })
		s.editing = false
	end
	if not in_draft then
		vim.api.nvim_win_set_cursor(0, { s.start + #s.draft, #s.draft[#s.draft] })
		key = "A"
	end
	mark(buf, s)
	M.lock(buf)
	-- feedkeys keeps normal Vim insertion semantics (including o/O and counts).
	local prefix = vim.v.count > 0 and tostring(vim.v.count) or ""
	vim.api.nvim_feedkeys(prefix .. (key or "i"), "ni", false)
end

function M.undo(buf, redo, count)
	local s = states[buf]
	if not s or not s.start then
		return
	end
	settle(buf, s)
	s.index = math.max(1, math.min(#s.undo, s.index + (redo and 1 or -1) * (count or 1)))
	s.draft = vim.deepcopy(s.undo[s.index])
	s.editing = true
	vim.bo[buf].modifiable = true
	vim.api.nvim_buf_set_lines(buf, s.start, -1, false, s.draft)
	s.editing = false
	mark(buf, s)
	M.lock(buf)
end

function M.submit(buf)
	local s = states[buf]
	if not s or not s.active then
		error("No running compilation")
	end
	settle(buf, s)
	local text = table.concat(s.draft, "\n")
	if text:sub(-1) ~= "\n" then
		text = text .. "\n"
	end
	local ok, err = s.send(text)
	if not ok then
		error(err)
	end
	if not s.start then
		-- :w without entering Insert still sends an empty answer.
		s.history = vim.api.nvim_buf_get_lines(buf, 0, -1, false)
		s.start = #s.history
	end
	local records = {}
	for _, line in ipairs(s.draft) do
		records[#records + 1] = "> " .. line
	end
	s.editing = true
	vim.bo[buf].modifiable = true
	vim.api.nvim_buf_set_lines(buf, s.start, -1, false, vim.list_extend(vim.deepcopy(records), { "" }))
	s.editing = false
	for i = 0, #records - 1 do
		s.records[s.start + i] = true
	end
	vim.list_extend(s.history, records)
	s.start = s.start + #records
	s.draft, s.undo, s.index = { "" }, { { "" } }, 1
	s.insert_group = false
	mark(buf, s)
	M.lock(buf)
end

function M.finish(buf)
	local s = states[buf]
	if not s then
		return
	end
	settle(buf, s)
	s.active = false
	if s.start and not M.has_draft(buf) then
		s.editing = true
		vim.bo[buf].modifiable = true
		vim.api.nvim_buf_set_lines(buf, s.start, -1, false, {})
		s.editing = false
		s.start = nil
		s.history = nil
	end
	mark(buf, s)
	M.lock(buf)
end

return M

				if inserting and s.insert_group then
					s.undo[s.index] = vim.deepcopy(s.draft)
				else
					s.undo[#s.undo + 1] = vim.deepcopy(s.draft)
					local limit = math.max(2, vim.go.undolevels + 1)
					if #s.undo > limit then
						table.remove(s.undo, 1)
					end
					s.index = #s.undo
				end
				s.insert_group = inserting
			end
		end,
		on_detach = function()
			if states[buf] == s then
				states[buf] = nil
			end
		end,
	})
	return s
end

function M.attach(buf, send)
	M.detach(buf)
	local session = { active = true, send = send }
	sessions[buf] = session
	-- :w must work even before the first Insert command.
	vim.bo[buf].buftype = "acwrite"
	vim.bo[buf].bufhidden = "hide"
	vim.api.nvim_create_autocmd({ "BufDelete", "BufWipeout" }, {
		group = group,
		buffer = buf,
		once = true,
		callback = function()
			if sessions[buf] == session then
				sessions[buf], states[buf] = nil, nil
			end
		end,
	})
end

function M.detach(buf)
	sessions[buf] = nil
	vim.api.nvim_clear_autocmds({ group = group, buffer = buf })
	local s = states[buf]
	if s and vim.api.nvim_buf_is_valid(buf) then
		settle(buf, s)
		vim.bo[buf].undolevels = s.old_undolevels
		vim.api.nvim_buf_clear_namespace(buf, ns, 0, -1)
	end
	states[buf] = nil
end

function M.enter(buf, key)
	local s = activate(buf)
	if not s or (not s.active and not s.start) then
		vim.notify("No running compilation", vim.log.levels.WARN)
		return
	end
	settle(buf, s)
	local in_draft = M.in_draft(buf)
	if not s.start then
		s.history = vim.api.nvim_buf_get_lines(buf, 0, -1, false)
		s.start = #s.history
		s.editing = true
		vim.bo[buf].modifiable = true
		vim.api.nvim_buf_set_lines(buf, -1, -1, false, { "" })
		s.editing = false
	end
	if not in_draft then
		vim.api.nvim_win_set_cursor(0, { s.start + #s.draft, #s.draft[#s.draft] })
		key = "A"
	end
	mark(buf, s)
	M.lock(buf)
	-- feedkeys keeps normal Vim insertion semantics (including o/O and counts).
	local prefix = vim.v.count > 0 and tostring(vim.v.count) or ""
	vim.api.nvim_feedkeys(prefix .. (key or "i"), "ni", false)
end

function M.undo(buf, redo, count)
	local s = states[buf]
	if not s or not s.start then
		return
	end
	settle(buf, s)
	s.index = math.max(1, math.min(#s.undo, s.index + (redo and 1 or -1) * (count or 1)))
	s.draft = vim.deepcopy(s.undo[s.index])
	s.editing = true
	vim.bo[buf].modifiable = true
	vim.api.nvim_buf_set_lines(buf, s.start, -1, false, s.draft)
	s.editing = false
	mark(buf, s)
	M.lock(buf)
end

function M.submit(buf)
	local s = activate(buf)
	if not s or not s.active then
		error("No running compilation")
	end
	settle(buf, s)
	local text = table.concat(s.draft, "\n")
	if text:sub(-1) ~= "\n" then
		text = text .. "\n"
	end
	local ok, err = s.send(text)
	if not ok then
		error(err)
	end
	if not s.start then
		-- :w without entering Insert still sends an empty answer.
		s.history = vim.api.nvim_buf_get_lines(buf, 0, -1, false)
		s.start = #s.history
	end
	local records = {}
	for _, line in ipairs(s.draft) do
		records[#records + 1] = "> " .. line
	end
	s.editing = true
	vim.bo[buf].modifiable = true
	vim.api.nvim_buf_set_lines(buf, s.start, -1, false, vim.list_extend(vim.deepcopy(records), { "" }))
	s.editing = false
	for i = 0, #records - 1 do
		s.records[s.start + i] = true
	end
	vim.list_extend(s.history, records)
	s.start = s.start + #records
	s.draft, s.undo, s.index = { "" }, { { "" } }, 1
	s.insert_group = false
	mark(buf, s)
	M.lock(buf)
end

function M.finish(buf)
	if sessions[buf] then
		sessions[buf].active = false
	end
	local s = states[buf]
	if not s then
		return
	end
	settle(buf, s)
	s.active = false
	if s.start and not M.has_draft(buf) then
		s.editing = true
		vim.bo[buf].modifiable = true
		vim.api.nvim_buf_set_lines(buf, s.start, -1, false, {})
		s.editing = false
		s.start = nil
		s.history = nil
	end
	mark(buf, s)
	M.lock(buf)
end

return M
